created_for: Startup Sim Godot employee autonomous activity visualization
storage_policy: Primary copy lives inside godot/StartupSimGodot/assets/art. External D:/美术资源/startup-sim copy is backup only.

source_tooling.post_processing: Pillow resize/crop to 1536x768, local chroma-key removal, sliced into individual icons
source_tooling.transparency: generated on #ff00ff chroma-key and converted to RGBA alpha

godot_import.suggested_usage: Sprite2D regions for EmployeeState.current_activity and office autonomous behavior
godot_import.alternate_usage: Use individual PNGs from exports/icons when atlas slicing is not desired.

notes: The atlas and all 32 sliced icons are transparent RGBA PNGs.
Rows intentionally vary age, face shape, hairstyle, outfit, accessory, expression, skin tone, pose, and facing direction.
No readable text, numbers, or UI labels are intended.
